title: Transformer delivery route checks and source records

oregon_case.project: Deschutes Solar and Battery Energy Storage System Facility
oregon_case.status: Preliminary application for site certificate under review in the November 2026 update
oregon_case.decision_scope: Field survey and comparison of proposed routes using representative vehicle geometry. Verify the selected carrier and final approvals before committing to a movement.

findings.finding: The preferred route would likely need a bypass at the I-84 and OR 197 interchange. The modeled transformer transporter could not make the turn safely as drawn.
findings.verification: Have the carrier check the full turn with the actual transport configuration and get any bypass or road work into the schedule.

findings.finding: The survey flagged an OR 216 bridge for early investigation and called for bridge and culvert analysis after carrier selection.
findings.verification: Have the road authority review the specific axle loads, axle spacing and crossings before relying on the route.

findings.check: Last leg to the transformer pad
findings.finding: Modifying the existing driveway would require about 2,700 feet of new roadway. The engineer proposed a new driveway and about 800 feet of new road instead.
findings.verification: Put the gate, pad, access rights, road works and construction dates on the same plan.

texas_permit_reference.scope: TxDMV instructions for a superheavy single-trip application unless an approved route is already on file. Actual authorization is specific to the movement, dates, origin and destination.
